description: Build a family caregiver's plan with ClinicalSwipe's navigator: public programs first, then what to ask the family doctor, then neighbor help, then what is not open yet, labeled as such. Every step names its source page and the date it was checked. A step that needs a clinician says who, what and why, and signs: true marks only the steps a program requires a clinician to sign or certify. General information from official program pages, not medical, legal or financial advice; each program decides its own eligibility. The answers go to clinicalswipe.com, which does not store or log them. Send no names or identifiers.

answers.description: Plain answers keyed by the questionnaire's question ids, using the codes caregiver_questionnaire lists, e.g. {"coverage":"medicare","doctor":"yes","state":"CO","situation":["memory"]}

format.description: "json" (default) or "fhir" for a FHIR R4 CarePlan. A QuestionnaireResponse always gets a CarePlan.

questionnaire_response.description: A FHIR R4 QuestionnaireResponse to the navigator questionnaire, instead of answers.

name: caregiver_plan
